description: This file defines the StringValueBinder class that implements the IValueBinder interface, providing methods to bind various types of values to spreadsheet cells by handling conversions and formatting options.

classes.name: StringValueBinder
classes.description: A class responsible for binding values to spreadsheet cells with options for value conversion.

methods.name: setNullConversion
methods.description: Sets whether null values should be converted.

methods.name: setBooleanConversion
methods.description: Sets whether boolean values should be converted.

methods.name: getBooleanConversion
methods.description: Returns the current boolean conversion setting.

methods.name: setNumericConversion
methods.description: Sets whether numeric values should be converted.

methods.name: setFormulaConversion
methods.description: Sets whether formula strings should be converted.

methods.name: setConversionForAllValueTypes
methods.description: Enables or disables conversion for all value types at once.

methods.name: bindValue
methods.description: Binds a value to a cell, handling conversion and formatting based on type.

methods.name: bindObjectValue
methods.description: Handles binding of object values, including date and rich text types.
